# Camp Resource: Pemmican Collector

Need a little trail food for the long journey ahead? Take this Pemmican with you!

Generates Pemmican.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Pemmican Collector__

**Produces**

Pemmican (Endurance Food Buff)

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resource

**Holds**

1 Pound (10 Pemmican)

**Obtainable via**

Season 17 Season Pass - Pioneer Scouts Skyline Valley - 40 tickets

Gold Bullion - Mortimer - Ally - 1250 Bullion

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 minutes and 12 Seconds

**Meat lasts X minutes in the collector**

No spoil

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units
